name: Juicy soy-glaze chicken breast strips (חזה עוף עסיסי וטעים)

source.notes: Reconstructed 2026-08-25 from a screenshot of this recipe's card in the Recipe Library artifact — the original analysis session/JSON for this recipe was not found in this repo, so this file recreates it from the visible per-100g values, ingredients, and tags on the card. If the original had different `analysis` scoring text, that couldn't be recovered from the screenshot.

serving_desc: ≈160 g cooked (1 kg raw chicken batch ÷ 5)
steps: Cut the breast into even, plump strips of uniform thickness and pat dry.
Marinate in soy sauce, olive oil, maple syrup/silan, water, sesame oil, sweet chili sauce, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, ginger, and salt.
Pan-fry in olive oil; thicken the glaze with cornflour.

him.verdict: High-protein, moderate-fat chicken batch — good for muscle retention and cutting; the soy/sweet-chili glaze adds sodium and added sugar worth watching if eating multiple servings.
suggested_mods: Pair with a big salad for fiber/lycopene, as already planned
Go easy on extra soy sauce at the table given the glaze's own sodium

her_preconception.verdict: Solid lean protein, iron, and choline. Sodium and added sugar are the only things to moderate; no raw/high-risk ingredients.
suggested_mods: Add a side of leafy greens for folate, which this dish doesn't provide
